recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x original clean group q1/q2/q3 x prior middle/base divergence x third consecutive top-group action), against the checked-in board surface. Construction through checkpoint 28 is inherited from a digest-pinned dependency; keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed. Only the immediate third top/index-zero whole-group single=false rotation is retained as the measured transition.

provenanceClaims.claim: Plain-R keyboard ingress requests whole-group rotation for the selected top card and forwards logical index zero.
Third-top single=false turn mutation, sibling rotation, unchanged per-card BREAK flags, selected-card margin rewrite, and action payload used by this capture.
Clicked top-card ingress resolves the containing zone and logical index zero used by rotate-card.
